Registry.Name: Identity Mask Registry
Registry.Hint: Internal storage for identity-mask aliases, display tiers, and identification records. Managed through the tracker/HUD controls; not edited directly.

Editor.Title: Identity Mask
Editor.Instructions: Players see the Public Alias while Masked and the Partial Alias while Partial (falls back to the Public Alias — never the true name). Skill, DC, and note are shared for this creature. A player row below is logged when an Outcome is selected; clear the Outcome to remove it. Leave the Public Alias empty and save, or press Clear, to remove the mask.
Editor.IdNoPlayers: No players in this world to log rolls for.
Editor.IdPlayerReadable: Caution: everything recorded here (skill, DC, note, and each player's roll total and outcome) is technically readable by all player clients. Records never change what players see — only the display tier control does that.

MaskAll.Title: Mask All Tokens of This Actor
MaskAll.Count: {count} of {total} same-actor tokens on this scene will be masked.
MaskAll.Overwrite: Overwrite existing masks (replaces their entries entirely)
MaskAll.NeedAlias: Enter a public alias before using Mask All.
MaskAll.NoTargets: No tokens to mask — every same-actor token on this scene already has a mask entry.

Warn.GmOnly: Only a GM may change identity masks.
Warn.SaveFailed: Failed to save identity-mask state. See the console for details.
Warn.NoToken: This combatant has no scene token and cannot be masked.
Warn.BadIdentification: Invalid identification data; nothing was saved.
Warn.MigrationMalformed: Identity-mask registry migration excluded {count} malformed items (see console).
